# i18n Conventions

All user-facing strings (UI labels, errors, log lines surfaced to the user, action status messages) MUST go through the i18n helper. Hard-coded English strings are not allowed in this scope.

## Import & Usage

```ts
import { t } from '@extension/i18n';

t('bg_errors_noTabId');                  // simple
t('act_goToUrl_start', ['https://example.com']); // with placeholders
```

## Key Naming: `component_category_specificAction_state`

Pick a prefix for the component:

| Prefix         | Use for                                    |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `bg_`          | Background service worker / `index.ts`     |
| `exec_`        | Executor / agent lifecycle                 |
| `act_`         | Agent actions (click, goToUrl, scroll, …)  |
| `errors_`      | Global / system-wide error messages        |
| `chat_`        | Chat interface elements                    |
| `nav_`         | Navigation elements                        |
| `options_`     | Settings page components                   |
| `permissions_` | Permission-related messages                |

Suffix with state when applicable: `_start`, `_ok`, `_fail`, `_cancel`, `_pause`.
Sub-bucket errors as `<prefix>_errors_<name>` (e.g. `act_errors_elementNotExist`).
Use `_cmd_` for commands (`bg_cmd_newTask_noTask`) and `_setup_` for configuration issues (`bg_setup_noApiKeys`).

Keep names self-documenting; do not collapse unrelated states into one key.

## Where to edit

- Edit source locale files only: [packages/i18n/locales/en/messages.json](packages/i18n/locales/en/messages.json) (and `pt_BR/`, `zh_TW/` for translations).
- Do NOT edit anything under [packages/i18n/lib/](packages/i18n/lib/) — those files are regenerated from JSON by [packages/i18n/genenrate-i18n.mjs](packages/i18n/genenrate-i18n.mjs) during the `@extension/i18n` workspace `ready`/`build` script.

## Placeholders

Use the Chrome i18n placeholder format with a documented `example`:

```json
{
  "act_goToUrl_start": {
    "message": "Navigating to $URL$",
    "placeholders": {
      "url": { "content": "$1", "example": "https://example.com" }
    }
  }
}
```

Pass placeholder values as an array in source order: `t('act_goToUrl_start', [url])`.

## Do / Don't

- Do: split internal log strings (developer-only) from user-facing strings — only the latter need a key.
- Do: reuse an existing key if the wording and semantics match exactly.
- Don't: concatenate translated fragments (`t('a') + ' ' + name`); use a placeholder instead.
- Don't: introduce a key in `en/` without also adding it to `pt_BR/` and `zh_TW/` (copy the English message as a fallback if no translation is available).
